newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - fuel oil jumps, gasoline falls.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - fuel oil jumps, gasoline falls.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Thursday, but fuel oil saw a late surge, dealer said.
Naphtha perked up with a rise in crude and buying in the swaps, but the wet market was balanced.
Gasoline fell, with Eurograde barges down $6 after yesterday's NYMEX drop and U.K. buying tapered off.
Higher European gas oil prices closed the arbitrage to India, but heating oil demand in Germany was picking up and talk continued of a squeeze on the IPE.
Cracked fuel barges climbed $3 in a late surge.
